page.content:
First YouTube video, shot at the San Diego Zoo on 23 April 2005.

How Me at the zoo connects

  • Character: Jawed Karim — Karim uploaded Me at the zoo, the first YouTube video.
  • Location: San Diego Zoo — Me at the zoo was filmed at the San Diego Zoo.
  • Topic: YouTube — Me at the zoo is the first clip in YouTube's public archive.

What is Me at the zoo?

Me at the zoo is eighteen seconds of Karim in front of elephants, the canonical first upload and still the site's oldest public clip.
